1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are __proofs of claim documents for debts owed by debtors to the creditors__;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations __and include debtor-specific information tailored to each debtor's bankruptcy case__; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations __by electronically transmitting the proofs of claim documents directly to each bankruptcy court's electronic filing system__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations __and the method further comprises validating each proof of claim document prior to filing to ensure compliance with the specific filing requirements of each court__.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim __that is specific to a particular debtor's bankruptcy case and includes creditor-specific claim information__;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations __by formatting each proof of claim according to the specific requirements and forms mandated by each bankruptcy court__;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations __by electronically submitting the formatted proofs of claim documents to each bankruptcy court's designated electronic filing system at scheduled intervals__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and the method further comprises automatically adapting the format and content of each proof of claim to comply with each court's specific filing rules and electronic submission requirements__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors __of the successful filing status and case numbers of their proofs of claims with each bankruptcy court, rather than merely notifying that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol __and storing the received data records in a centralized database that is accessible only to authorized creditors and system administrators__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __that requires creditor authentication and provides a user interface specifically designed for entering debtor-specific claim information__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode __by electronically transmitting batches to each bankruptcy court__ at least once per day.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __specific to each creditor showing the status of all proofs of claims filed on behalf of that creditor__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor __via the Web site or secure electronic transmission__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __and specifying a date range and particular bankruptcy cases for which filing status is requested__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __due to validation failures, missing required information, or court system unavailability__.

15. (Originally presented) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Originally presented) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Originally presented) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record.
